title: crate_changed v1
description: One edit to a crate. Devices rebuild crates by replaying these in id order (docs/crates.md). Every field but crate_id is optional; an event carries only what changed.

crate_id.description: Minted lowercase by the device that created the crate.

name.description: Creates the crate, renames it, or brings a deleted one back (empty).

deleted.description: Deletes the crate and empties it.

added.description: Track keys (lowercase hex SHA-256 of the audio file) appended to the crate.
